Re: Non-Binding Letter of Intent — Lease of Suite 400, 1400 Merchant Street, Denver, Colorado

Dear Ms. Fenwick:

This letter of intent (this "LOI") sets out the principal business terms on which Merchant Street Holdings, LLC ("Landlord") and Northgate Diagnostics, Inc. ("Tenant") would be willing to negotiate a lease of the premises described below. Except for Sections 12, 13 and 14, this LOI is non-binding and creates no obligation on either party.

1. Premises. Suite 400 on the fourth floor of the building located at 1400 Merchant Street, Denver, Colorado (the "Building"), containing approximately 14,250 rentable square feet as measured under BOMA 2017 standards (the "Premises"). The parties acknowledge that the rentable square feet figure is subject to verification by Landlord's architect before lease execution.

2. Use. General office and clinical laboratory use, subject to Landlord's confirmation that the proposed laboratory use complies with the Building's certificate of occupancy and applicable zoning.

3. Term. One hundred twenty-six (126) months, commencing on the Commencement Date, which is expected to be January 1, 2027.

4. Base Rent. Base Rent shall be $34.50 per rentable square foot per year for the first Lease Year, payable in equal monthly installments in advance on the first day of each month, escalating three percent (3%) on each anniversary of the Commencement Date.

5. Free Rent. Tenant shall receive six (6) months of free Base Rent, applied to months one through six of the Term. Tenant remains responsible for its share of Operating Expenses during the free rent period.

6. Operating Expenses. The Lease will be a modified gross lease with a base year of 2027. Tenant shall pay its proportionate share of increases in Operating Expenses and real estate taxes over the base year, subject to a five percent (5%) annual cap on controllable Operating Expenses, cumulative and compounding.

7. Tenant Improvement Allowance. Landlord shall provide a tenant improvement allowance of $85.00 per rentable square foot, disbursed against invoices for hard and soft costs of the initial buildout. Landlord shall deliver the Premises with the base building systems in good working order.

8. Security Deposit. Two (2) months of Base Rent, in cash or by letter of credit at Tenant's election, reducible by half after the thirtieth (30th) month if Tenant has not been in monetary default.

9. Renewal Option. One (1) option to renew for sixty (60) months at ninety-five percent (95%) of fair market rent, exercisable by written notice given no earlier than fifteen (15) and no later than twelve (12) months before expiration.

10. Parking. Three (3) unreserved spaces per 1,000 rentable square feet at the Building's then-prevailing monthly rate, plus four (4) reserved spaces at no charge during the initial Term.

11. Brokers. Landlord is represented by Bridgeport Commercial Realty and Tenant is represented by Callahan Tenant Advisors. Landlord shall pay both commissions under a separate agreement.

12. Exclusivity. From the date Tenant countersigns this LOI until the earlier of (a) June 15, 2026 and (b) written notice from either party that negotiations have terminated, Landlord shall not offer the Premises to, or negotiate a lease of the Premises with, any other prospective tenant. This Section 12 is binding.

13. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the terms of this LOI and the fact of the parties' negotiations confidential, and shall not disclose them except to its own officers, employees, attorneys, accountants, lenders and brokers who need to know them and who are bound to keep them confidential, or as required by law. This Section 13 is binding and survives any termination of negotiations for a period of two (2) years.

14. Governing Law; Binding Effect. This Section 14, together with Sections 12 and 13, is binding on the parties and is governed by the laws of the State of Colorado, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. All other provisions of this LOI are a statement of intent only. Neither party is obligated to negotiate, to continue negotiating, or to enter into a lease, and no lease shall exist unless and until a definitive written lease is executed and delivered by both parties. Neither party shall have any liability to the other for terminating negotiations at any time, for any reason or no reason.

15. Expenses. Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses, including attorneys' fees, incurred in connection with this LOI and the negotiation of a lease.

If the foregoing reflects your understanding, please countersign below and return one copy. We look forward to working with you.

Very truly yours,

MERCHANT STREET HOLDINGS, LLC

By: /s/ Gregory Amaral
